faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does moncabinetcric ensure compliance with CICC regulations?
faq.a1: Our architecture strictly adheres to College record-keeping requirements: timestamped immutable user logs, Canadian data hosting, and strict segregation of staging and production data.
faq.q2: What is the difference between the commercial pipeline and the casework pipeline?
faq.a2: The commercial pipeline tracks prospects until retainer signature. Once converted, the client enters the regulatory pipeline (IRCC / MIFI) with distinct milestones, never skewing your sales analytics.
faq.q3: Are international clients automatically exempted from Canadian sales taxes?
faq.a3: Yes. Our tax engine automatically applies provincial rules (GST/PST/HST or international tax exemption) based on client residency, generating compliant invoices with manual override option.
faq.q4: Can I export an entire client file in case of an inspection or transfer?
faq.a4: Absolutely. In one click, you can generate a consolidated archive (merged PDF or ZIP) containing client history, notes, retainer agreements, and all uploaded proofs.
